name: bridge-tender
title: A sealed tender to build a bridge
runs: in an Agent Middleground: bids stay sealed there, and only the results leave.

steps.does: Approves the result worked out by the rules

rules.score: 70 points for price (the lowest eligible price gets all 70), 30 points for similar projects done (6 per project, at most 30)

records: The middle ground keeps a log of fingerprints only. After the result, the bids are wiped; each company keeps its own confirmation token.
